Key takeaways Premium Earbuds Discounted Amazon is currently offering the JBL Live Buds 3 noise-canceling wireless earbuds for $91.99, a 54% reduction from their standard $200 price point. This promotion precedes the traditional Black Friday shopping period. Device Features and Co

Premium Earbuds Discounted

Amazon is currently offering the JBL Live Buds 3 noise-canceling wireless earbuds for $91.99, a 54% reduction from their standard $200 price point. This promotion precedes the traditional Black Friday shopping period.

Device Features and Compatibility

The earbuds feature a unique smart charging case equipped with a 1.45-inch touchscreen for audio control without a smartphone. The hardware includes 10mm drivers, an IP55 water and dust resistance rating, and a total battery life of 40 hours when combined with the case.

While compatible with both operating systems, the device is optimized for Android, supporting features such as Google Fast Pair, Google Audio Switch, and LDAC codec. iOS users can utilize the earbuds for audio playback but may lack specific ecosystem integrations found in Apple-proprietary hardware. Consumers can verify current pricing and technical specifications at the official listing: https://www.ign.com/articles/jbl-live-buds-3-noise-canceling-wireless-earbuds-deal-october-2026.
